claims.text: Many reviewers with curly, wavy, or thick hair say it straightens effectively and leaves hair smooth and full of body.
Reviewers frequently praise how fast and easy it is to use, often comparing it favorably to flat irons.
Some reviewers report it did not straighten their hair well or that the heat settings were insufficient.
A few reviewers mention hair damage or drying, though others say it is less damaging than a flat iron.
Some reviewers note design issues, such as the on/off button or the brush needing smaller sections for natural hair.
